title: Module Management
codex_guardrail: Keep module enable/disable and dependency controls. Do not implement SaaS billing/plan mechanics unless separately approved.

title: Offer Management
codex_guardrail: Governed offer lifecycle: Draft → Approval → Sent → Accepted/Declined. Preserve candidate/application lineage into Employee conversion.

title: Security Center
codex_guardrail: Support password, TOTP, email OTP, session management and recent security activity. Do not expose SMS OTP or recovery phone until a reliable SMS provider exists.

title: Roles & Permissions
codex_guardrail: System roles remain protected. UI permission buckets must map to granular backend permissions; backend authorization is authoritative.

title: Institution Profile
codex_guardrail: Logo, legal identity, institution type, country, default currency, timezone and contact data. Currency formatting preferences must not silently change transaction currency.

title: Users & Access
codex_guardrail: Members, invitations and access requests. Invitation links should be one-time/expiring; access changes require backend role assignments and audit.

title: Employee Home
codex_guardrail: Daily employee workspace, not an executive dashboard. Show only own records and enabled modules; no invented performance scores.

title: Request Leave
codex_guardrail: Support draft, half-day boundaries, working-day calculation, attachments, balance preview and approval-route preview. Policy rules are institution-configured.

title: My Documents
codex_guardrail: Categories, issue/expiry dates, status and uploads. Only show storage quota if the backend actually enforces one.

title: Personal Preferences
codex_guardrail: Locale, timezone, date/time/number formatting, appearance, accessibility and notification preferences. User formatting does not alter accounting currency values.

title: Vendor Bill Detail
codex_guardrail: Document view, approval route, attachments and payment status. Scheduling/recording payment must not imply an external bank transfer unless an integration exists.

title: Budget Detail — Academic Affairs
codex_guardrail: Allocated, actual, remaining and variance are valid targets. 'Committed' must not be shown until a legitimate commitment source such as Procurement/POs exists.

title: Job Requisition Detail
codex_guardrail: Requisition lifecycle, hiring team, approval and publish controls. Approval must complete before publish when configured.

title: Financial Report Detail — Statement of Financial Position
codex_guardrail: Formal statement output must be generated from authoritative posted accounting data. Do not expose PDF/XLSX/XBRL export options unless backend exporters exist.

title: Reports & Analytics Catalogue
codex_guardrail: Stage implementation: catalogue → saved configurations → sharing/access → scheduling. Do not attempt a generic BI/report-builder platform first.

title: Notification Center
codex_guardrail: In-app + email only for Phase 2. Deep links use controlled route_name/resource_id and re-check source authorization; no arbitrary trusted URLs.

title: Recruitment Dashboard
codex_guardrail: Pipeline should reflect real configured lifecycle stages and authoritative counts. Requisition creation is a real Phase 2 domain addition.

title: Global Search
codex_guardrail: Institution- and permission-scoped cross-module search. Authorization must scope retrieval before results are returned, not fetch-all-then-hide.

title: Governed Empty, Error & Loading States
codex_guardrail: Canonical no-data, loading, error, no-access, validation and zero-result patterns. Sample AP content is illustrative only and does not authorize Procurement/Purchase Orders.

title: Confirmation Dialog Patterns
codex_guardrail: Standardize confirmations for reversible, destructive and governed actions. Domain backend remains responsible for actual authorization, lifecycle and audit.

title: Workflow Transitions & Correction Handoffs
codex_guardrail: Use as the canonical visual pattern for governed transitions, corrections, reversals and linked records. Do not force all domains into one database model; each domain owns its valid state machine.

title: Record Actions & Lifecycle States
codex_guardrail: Use as a reusable lifecycle-action pattern. Draft may be deletable when unreferenced; active/archived/finalized/immutable states require domain-specific safeguards. Finalized/immutable records use correction/reversal rather than destructive edit.

title: Employee Home — Operational Variant
codex_guardrail: Variant of Employee Home. Keep useful personal actions, shift/attendance and attention items, but remove organization/team information that exceeds the employee's authorized scope. Do not introduce invented productivity/performance measures.

title: Approvals — Governance Review Variant
codex_guardrail: Approval inbox variant with richer governance/audit detail. Procurement/PO examples are illustrative only and do not authorize adding Procurement. Batch/quick approvals require backend eligibility checks and per-record audit.

title: Employee Directory — Filter Drawer Variant
codex_guardrail: Responsive/compact Employee Directory variant with KPI cards and filter drawer. Reuse canonical Employee Directory contracts and field-level RBAC. Do not create a second employee listing domain.

title: Approvals Inbox — Pending Decisions
codex_guardrail: Canonical cross-module approvals inbox candidate. Leave, finance and attendance decisions must be backed by real approval requests and permissions. Procurement/PO sample content is illustrative only. 'Approve All' requires explicit batch eligibility and per-record authorization/audit.
